name: Chetana local rules and entity extraction
use_for: OTP, UPI, APK, remote-access, KYC, digital-arrest, job, courier, and merchant patterns
limitations: Pattern matching is advisory and cannot prove that an identifier is clean.
Needs periodic refresh from real incident reports and sponsor feedback.

name: Google Cloud Web Risk
use_for: thin link risk before a user opens a site
limitations: URL-only signal; does not verify UPI IDs, phone numbers, screenshots, or caller intent.
Requires a Google Cloud project, quota governance, and privacy review before sending user-submitted URLs.
Lookup API pricing currently includes 100,000 calls per month at no charge, then usage pricing.

name: Google Safe Browsing API
limitations: Google states that Safe Browsing API is for non-commercial use only and directs commercial users to Web Risk.
Do not wire this API into a sponsored, bank, government, or revenue-generating Chetana deployment.

name: abuse.ch URLhaus
use_for: local denylist seeding for suspicious links
limitations: The current API requires an Auth-Key; the old anonymous refresh assumption is stale.
Focused on malware infrastructure, not consumer scam persuasion.
A missing hit must never be treated as safe.

name: PhishTank
limitations: Community feed quality and freshness vary.
Does not cover phone, UPI, QR intent, or screenshot-only scams.

name: Phishing.Database community feeds
use_for: regression fixtures with source and retrieval timestamps
limitations: Community feeds require freshness, deduplication, source attribution, and false-positive controls.
A missing hit must never be treated as safe.

name: OpenPhish
limitations: OpenPhish terms restrict the service to personal use and prohibit commercial use without prior written consent.
Do not use the community feed in Chetana sponsor or institutional pilots without a signed license.
A no-match is not a clean verdict.

name: VirusTotal API v3
use_for: APK hash or file reputation checks when user consent allows
limitations: Submitting files or URLs to a third party requires clear consent and privacy classification.
VirusTotal states that its Public API must not be used in commercial products or services; a premium agreement is required.

name: urlscan.io
limitations: Public scans can expose submitted URLs and metadata unless configured carefully.
Not appropriate for private bank links or sensitive screenshots by default.

name: Cloudflare URL Scanner
use_for: analyst investigation of suspicious public URLs
redirect, network, screenshot, and phishing-verdict enrichment
limitations: Scans are public by default; unlisted scans remain accessible to anyone who knows the scan ID.
Successful scans are retained for 12 months, so private bank links and user-specific URLs must not be submitted by default.
Use only after URL extraction, sensitivity classification, and explicit user or analyst consent.

name: ICANN Registration Data Access Protocol
use_for: domain registration age as supporting evidence
structured replacement for legacy WHOIS lookups
limitations: Chetana sends only the normalized hostname after explicit consent; URL paths and query strings are not sent.
A recent registration is a weak risk signal, not proof of fraud.
An old domain, missing record, or failed lookup must never be treated as safe.

name: National Cyber Crime Portal suspect repository
use_for: manual lookup of phone numbers, UPI IDs, account numbers, and suspicious identifiers
official second check when identifiers are extracted
limitations: No stable public API is treated as available.
Complaint-based lookup is not a definitive safe/unsafe verdict.

name: Sanchar Saathi Chakshu
use_for: suspected fraud communication reports by call, SMS, or WhatsApp before money is lost
limitations: Not a general cybercrime complaint replacement.
If money is lost, Chetana must still route to 1930 and cybercrime.gov.in first.

name: The420.in
use_for: human review of India cybercrime trends
limitations: No stable public machine API observed.
Editorial reports must not be used as automated verdict ground truth.
The420 Search Engine was observed as a site feature, not a confirmed API.

name: Reserve Bank of India public guidance and CMS
limitations: Policy guidance, not a live scam identifier database.
Chetana should summarize and route, not provide legal advice.
